header.overviewDescription: What Vitana knows about you – and how your week in the Vitana Index went.
header.permissionsDescription: You decide what Vitana learns from. Nobody else sees this data.

week.title: Your week in the Vitana Index
week.empty: No Vitana Index yet. Take the starting check – then this card tells you every week what moved.

routines.title: Routines Vitana noticed
routines.description: This is how Vitana learns your days. Let it forget anything that isn't right.

switches.title: What Vitana may learn from
switches.description: Off means: Vitana no longer uses this area for conversations, routines and recommendations. Your entries stay on your timeline.
switches.appUsageDescription: Which areas you open and when. Never shown – Vitana only uses it to recognise your routines.
switches.appUsageOff: Switching off also deletes the routines Vitana learned from it.
switches.healthNote: Health data stays protected by your consents as well.
switches.unavailable: These switches will be available shortly.

usage.title: Your usage data
usage.description: Screen visits and technical traces. They never appear on your timeline.
usage.countUnavailable: The overview will be available shortly.
usage.deleteDescription: Screen visits and technical traces are deleted, together with the routines Vitana learned from them. Your timeline stays.
